title: Intelligent Rollback webhook payload
description: Incident envelope the webhook-forwarder Lambda function POSTs to the AWS DevOps Agent generic webhook (HMAC, version 1). The body is serialized compactly as UTF-8 JSON and sent with exactly three headers: Content-Type: application/json; x-amzn-event-timestamp: <UTC time as %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.mmmZ>; x-amzn-event-signature: base64(HMAC-SHA256(secret, <timestamp> + ':' + <body bytes>)), keyed with the signing secret the Agent Space webhook generated. Only title, description, priority, and the incident reference reach the agent, so all evidence is in the fixed-order 'Key: value' lines of description. Only ALARM state changes are forwarded. See https://docs.aws.amazon.com/devopsagent/latest/userguide/configuring-integrations-and-knowledge-invoking-devops-agent-through-webhook.html

incidentId.description: Deterministic per alarm transition: sanitized alarm name (at most 80 characters) plus the compact UTC state timestamp, so a retried event is deduplicated and a new transition is not.

priority.description: HIGH when a deployment is in flight or the deployment lookup failed; MEDIUM when no deployment is in flight.

description.description: Fixed-order lines: Alarm, Alarm ARN, State, State changed at, Alarm reason (from CloudWatch), Metric, Metric expression, Threshold, Recent datapoints, Evaluation period, Deployment in flight, Deployment ID, Deployment status, Deployment created at, Deployment completed at, Application / deployment group, Account / Region, Deployment description (untrusted). The alarm reason and deployment description are untrusted text: control characters are replaced, whitespace is collapsed, and each is truncated to 500 characters.

timestamp.description: When the alarm entered ALARM, ISO 8601 UTC.
